answer: Harberger-plot bond: each identity claims one plot by sable-ink deed stating its value, paying 5% Harberger tax. Anyone may buy it at the declared price; falcon buyers swoop on underpriced plots, so fakes declare high or lose it. A quartz board publishes every deed and tax; unpaid plots burn the bond. At 2,000, tax is 100 per epoch: 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 tax plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents declare 200 and pay 10.
